jobs.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one premium mobile-game cosmetic store portrait, a finished polished high-end stylized 3D character render, SQUARE 1024x1024. Reference image is the exact character identity and materials; compose a new marketing close-up, do not reproduce a sprite sheet. Background: very dark midnight indigo-violet studio gradient (#100d25), quiet and uncluttered, soft subtle violet/cyan rim lighting, restrained high-quality highlights. Composition: one character, head and upper torso/bust fills 80% of tile, head complete with ears/crest fully visible with safe margin, chest cropped at lower edge, clear silhouette and readable at 80px. Camera three-quarter facing slightly right, premium product photography polish, crisp material detail and appealing character personality. Keep the compact animal character identity; do not turn the torso into a long human body. NO text, numbers, names, prices, logos, watermarks, borders, icons, buttons, ground, floor, cast ground shadow, floating cubes, extra items, duplicated characters. This is marketing art only, not a gameplay pose or animation sheet. Subject: Porcelain Paragon, the exact silver squirrel in reference, ALWAYS wearing its fully closed ivory porcelain Sovereign Shell helmet with cobalt-blue opaque horizontal visor. Preserve cobalt botanical filigree, midnight-blue inset suit, platinum trim and blue star medallion. Silver fur ears in the same approved positions, no exposed face/eyes behind visor. Fluffy silver squirrel tail peeks behind the shoulder as an identity detail. Emphasize exquisite ivory glaze, crisp blue botanical painting and blue glass. Show a purposeful proud compact squirrel chest and rounded shoulder armor, not broad human shoulders.
